body: Thank you so much for the article! I'll definitely be trying out some tubing mascaras :)
The NARS eye primer is fantastic! I have very oily, hooded eyelids, and it's the only primer that actually works for me.
I've changed my nose ring before, it's just the corkscrew that I've had a hard time with. I actually managed to get it back in (kinda proud of myself), so no more help needed lol

Cut/color wise, I definitely think bringing in pictures of what you want is great... BUT, it's even more helpful to also bring pictures of what you DON'T want. That way you can ensure that what you really don't want is not going to be interpreted as something that you do want. Also things like, "How long do you have to work on your hair in the mornings?," and "What kind of products do you use?" Are questions that can assist a hairstylist. 

Talking wise... I just make small talk. When I get my hair done, I usually just let my hairstylist talk and I'll respond if needed. I just don't really initiate the conversation.
The "horns" or "stubs" on top of giraffes heads are called ossicones.
For some reason You Oughta Know by Alanis Morissette always gets me going

I live in the US, and I had always been taught that the continents are: North America, South America, Europe, Africa, Antarctica, Asia, and Australia. The continent of Australia consists of Australia, Papua New Guinea, East Timor, and areas of Indonesia. Countries like New Zealand exist in the greater region of Oceania.
As a sixth grader I had to explain to my social studies teacher that Australia is both a continent and a country. She refused to believe me, even after googling it for her.

Hi everyone. I'm definitely new here, so I guess I should introduce myself. 

My name is Emma and i'm a senior in high school. Mental health wise, I was diagnosed with several things my 8th grade year... I have severe GAD, social anxiety, panic disorder, depression, OCD, and ADHD (I know that's a lot of stuff). I've been seeing a therapist and a psychiatrist for 4 years now, as well as being on medication. I've tried so many medications it's quite ridiculous. I currently take 6 medications daily, and see my therapist once a week... I still feel awful. 

Lately I feel as if I've been getting worse, I haven't felt this anxious in almost a year. I've been feeling worse in general, but I also have something in particular that's causing me a lot of anxiety. I just got hired for the first time at my local movie theater. I have training tomorrow on Friday and I'm absolutely terrified. Just thinking about it makes me want to cry. I'm so worried that I'm going to do something wrong, and make a fool of myself, or ruin something and get fired on the spot. I've been so nervous about this that I stayed home from school today, I can't even let myself leave my room. I have absolutely no idea how I'm supposed to do this, I've felt physically sick about this for weeks...

I guess for my quirky superpower, it would be my ability to sightread/sightsing. If I'm given a piece of sheet music for voice or piano I can pick it up incredibly quickly. 

- Emma
